article.title: Numerales en casos oblicuos
article.part: Numerales y comparación — Числительные и сравнение
article.chapter: Numerales, cantidades y gobierno de caso — Числительные, количество и управление падежом

claims.summary: In Russian, 'oblique cases' refer to cases other than nominative, including genitive, dative, accusative, instrumental, and prepositional. When a numeral appears within a nominal group in one of these cases, its form can change along with the counted noun.

The specific form of a numeral depends on the numeral itself. For example, 'один' declines like an adjective, while 'два/две, три, четыре' have forms like 'двух, трёх, четырёх' in genitive; 'двум, трём, четырём' in dative; and 'двумя, тремя, четырьмя' in instrumental.

The article provides several examples demonstrating the use of numerals in different cases, such as 'с пятью студентами' ('with five students'), 'Мы помогли пяти семьям' ('We helped five families'), and 'Она говорила с двадцатью студентами' ('She spoke with twenty students').
